europe_now.title: German Police Arrest Suspected Power Grid Saboteur
europe_now.summary: German law enforcement has taken a suspected saboteur into custody following an extensive manhunt targeting attacks on national critical infrastructure.

top_stories.title: France and Allies Implement Trade Sanctions on Israeli Settlements
top_stories.summary: France, the United Kingdom, and Canada are joining other nations to enforce bans on products originating from West Bank settlements. In response to the measures, Israeli officials announced plans to close the British consulate in Jerusalem.

top_stories.title: Resumption of Major Strikes and Conflict Across Ukraine
top_stories.summary: Russian military forces have renewed heavy bombardments targeting Kyiv, concluding a brief pause that coincided with diplomatic discussions involving United States envoys. Meanwhile, regional updates note ongoing territorial shifts and continued operational developments on the front lines.
